anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Victor Zhang. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 720 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Thornfield answers! Elena Nakamura and Zoe Dubois and Andre Mendez and Cole Murphy and Elena Diallo and Sam Nakamura will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Dmitri, Elif, Clinton step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Dmitri, Elif, Clinton march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 9 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
🍽️ The muster is hungry — 130 of 9,000 kcal fed. Bellies remember who feeds them. (loyalty strains when the food runs thin.) (trust −2 per fire per day while the muster stands hungry.)

🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
